Provenance.drafts: Seed 714020, batch of 4 at 896x1152. #2 and #4 both generated a street scene rather than one building. #3 was a near tie with #1. #1 won on silhouette: the gable, chimney and hanging sign all separate against the backdrop, which is what survives a downsample to 187px.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA at 0.9/0.9) diffuse, one ComfyUI KSampler pass at 896x1152, seed 714020, dpmpp_2m/karras, 30 steps, cfg 7.0, batch of 4. IPAdapter (vit-h, style transfer, weight 0.9) referenced market.png so palette and lighting lock to the Shop the owner named as art he likes -- the same chain this file recorded for the previous render, re-run rather than reinvented. Background removed by art/pipeline/gen-venues-r14.py's deterministic border-seeded flood fill against the border-median reference colour, then cropped to the alpha box, BOX-downsampled straight to the target height, and padded 1px of transparency on every side (VenueArtContractTests assertion 1). Sized to 187px = 5.50x the tallest resolved character body, ranked by role inside R14.8's 3.5-5.5x band rather than scaled uniformly: a uniform multiplier would have left the smaller buildings still undersized, which is the complaint (#142) still open. Replaces the render this file previously described, which measured 1.41-2.59x and is what made the heroes look too big for the town.
